summary.text: Will Metcalf is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 16 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a bank executive.

paragraphs.text: Will Metcalf earned a B.S. in criminal justice from Sam Houston State University.
His professional experience includes working as an assistant vice president of Spirit of Texas Bank.
Metcalf first assumed office in 2015, and Ballotpedia lists his early committee assignments as Economic & Small Business Development and Homeland Security & Public Safety.
In 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 he chaired the House Administration Committee, and in 2023-2024 he also served on the Natural Resources and House State Affairs committees.
In 2014, according to Ballotpedia, his campaign website highlighted securing the border, opposing federal overreach, local control of education, and the water supply.
